title: Cohomology of affine derived pushforward
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $E$ be an object of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. For every integer $i$, the cohomology sheaf of the derived direct image satisfies $H^i(Rf_*E)\cong f_*H^i(E)$, and $f_*H^i(E)$ is quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Since $f$ is affine, the affine higher-direct-image statement [lem-pc-affine-morphism-hi] gives $R^pf_*\mathcal F=0$ for all $p>0$ and every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$. This is exactly the hypothesis of the cohomology comparison for derived direct images with quasi-coherently acyclic pushforward [lem-sc-qcoh-acyclic-derived-pushforward-cohomology], which applies to every (possibly unbounded) $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ and gives a natural isomorphism $H^i(Rf_*E)\cong f_*H^i(E)$ for every integer $i$, where $Rf_*$ and its cohomology sheaves are those of [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. (A representative of $E$ need not have quasi-coherent terms, and for unbounded $E$ termwise pushforward does not compute $Rf_*E$; this is why the comparison is a cited statement, Stacks Tag 08D4 applied to $\Gamma(f^{-1}V,-)$ for affine opens $V\subseteq Y$, the 'small detail omitted' of Tag 0AVW.)

proof.text: The same affine higher-direct-image statement also says that $f_*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent whenever $\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent. Taking $\mathcal F=H^i(E)$, which is quasi-coherent because $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$, shows that the sheaf $f_*H^i(E)$ in the comparison is quasi-coherent.
